name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.lift
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ) (g : Module.End ℤ_[l] X), GenBy l R X →
∃ S : Matrix (Fin R) (Fin R) ℤ_[l], ∀ c : ℤ_[l], cokLen (c • g - 1) ≤ vl l (c • S - 1).det := by
intro l _ X _ _ R g hgen
choose s hs using fun j : Fin R => hπ (g (π (Pi.single j 1)))
refine ⟨Matrix.of fun i j => s j i, fun c => ?_⟩
have hcomm : ∀ v : Fin R → ℤ_[l], π (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.of fun i j => s j i) v) = g (π v) := by
have h : π ∘ₗ (Matrix.of fun i j => s j i).mulVecLin = g ∘ₗ π := by
set A : Matrix (Fin R) (Fin R) ℤ_[l] := c • (Matrix.of fun i j => s j i) - 1 with hA
have hcommA : ∀ v, π (A.mulVecLin v) = (c • g - 1) (π v) := by
Matrix.one_mulVec, map_sub, map_smul, hcomm, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
let φ : (Fin R → ℤ_[l]) →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] X ⧸ LinearMap.range (c • g - 1) :=
have hker : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.ker φ := by
have hsurj : Function.Surjective ((LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin).liftQ φ hker) := by
show: Let X be a ℤℓ-module generated by R elements and let g be a ℤℓ-linear endomorphism. There exists an R-by-R matrix S over ℤℓ such that for every c in ℤℓ, the cokernel length of cg−I is at most the extended additive valuation of det(cS−I).
strategy: Lift g through a surjection from a free module by choosing a preimage of each image of a generator. The resulting matrix S works for every c in ℤℓ. The cokernel of cS−I surjects onto the cokernel of cg−I.

steps.claim: Choose a surjection $\pi:F=\mathbf Z_\ell^R\to X$. For each standard vector $e_j$, lift $g(\pi e_j)$ to a vector $s_j\in F$ by surjectivity. The matrix $S$ with columns $s_j$ is independent of the scalar $c$.
steps.snippet:
∃ S : Matrix (Fin R) (Fin R) ℤ_[l], ∀ c : ℤ_[l], cokLen (c • g - 1) ≤ vl l (c • S - 1).det := by
  intro l _ X _ _ R g hgen
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := hgen
  choose s hs using fun j : Fin R => hπ (g (π (Pi.single j 1)))
  refine ⟨Matrix.of fun i j => s j i, fun c => ?_⟩

steps.claim: For every $v\in F$, one has $\pi(Sv)=g(\pi v)$ because both sides are linear and their values at the basis vectors agree.
steps.snippet: have hcomm : ∀ v : Fin R → ℤ_[l], π (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.of fun i j => s j i) v) = g (π v) := by
steps.typedFact: ∀ v : Fin R → ℤ_[l], π (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.of fun i j => s j i) v) = g (π v)

children.claim: On $e_j$, the first composite $\pi S$ takes the value $\pi(s_j)=g(\pi e_j)$ because $s_j$ is the $j$-th column. Agreement on the standard basis proves $\pi S=g\pi$ as maps out of $F$.
children.snippet:
have h : π ∘ₗ (Matrix.of fun i j => s j i).mulVecLin = g ∘ₗ π := by
      ext j
      simp [Matrix.mulVec_single_one]
      rw [← hs j]
      rfl
children.typedFact: π ∘ₗ (Matrix.of fun i j => s j i).mulVecLin = g ∘ₗ π

children.claim: Evaluating the equality of linear maps at any $v\in F$ gives $\pi(Sv)=g(\pi v)$.
children.snippet:
intro v
    simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun h v

steps.claim: For the fixed scalar $c$, put $A=cS-I$. This matrix acts on the same free module $F$.
steps.snippet: set A : Matrix (Fin R) (Fin R) ℤ_[l] := c • (Matrix.of fun i j => s j i) - 1 with hA

steps.claim: The corresponding shifted maps intertwine as well, since $\pi(Av)=c\pi(Sv)-\pi(v)=(cg-I)\pi(v)$.
steps.snippet:
have hcommA : ∀ v, π (A.mulVecLin v) = (c • g - 1) (π v) := by
    intro v
    simp only [hA, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec,
      Matrix.one_mulVec, map_sub, map_smul, hcomm, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      Module.End.one_apply]

steps.claim: Let $\varphi:F\to X/(cg-I)X$ be $\pi$ followed by the quotient map. It sends $v$ to the class of $\pi(v)$.
steps.snippet:
let φ : (Fin R → ℤ_[l]) →ₗ[ℤ_[l]] X ⧸ LinearMap.range (c • g - 1) :=
    (LinearMap.range (c • g - 1)).mkQ ∘ₗ π

steps.claim: The image $AF$ lies in $\ker\varphi$ since $\pi(Av)=(cg-I)(\pi v)$ is zero in the target quotient.
steps.snippet:
have hker : LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.ker φ := by
    rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, φ, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
      Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    rw [hcommA]
    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _

steps.claim: The induced map $F/AF\to X/(cg-I)X$ is surjective. A target class has a representative $y\in X$, and surjectivity of $\pi$ gives $v\in F$ with $\pi v=y$, so the class of $v$ maps to the given class.
steps.snippet:
have hsurj : Function.Surjective ((LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin).liftQ φ hker) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective _ x
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hπ y
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk v, rfl⟩

steps.claim: This surjection bounds the target length by $\operatorname{length}_{\mathbf Z_\ell}(F/AF)=v_\ell(\det A)$, the determinant formula for a square matrix over $\mathbf Z_\ell$. Since $A=cS-I$, this gives the desired bound for every $c$, including the infinite value when $\det A=0$.
steps.snippet:
have hlen := Module.length_le_of_surjective _ hsurj
  have hdet := KStar.Selmer.length_cokernel_eq_addVal_det A
  unfold cokLen
  exact hlen.trans_eq hdet

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
